creationOrderRationale: SG 간 sourceSg 참조이므로 참조 대상이 먼저 존재해야 함 — alb-sg → app-sg(refs alb-sg) → db-sg(refs app-sg) → bastion-sg → vpc-endpoint-sg(refs app-sg)

securityGroups.name: app-sg
securityGroups.description: ECS Task in app subnet — accepts only from alb-sg on container port

ingress.description: Spring Boot container port from ALB only

egress.description: all outbound (ECR pull · Secrets Manager · CloudWatch Logs · external API via NAT)

securityGroups.name: db-sg
securityGroups.description: RDS MySQL — accepts only from app-sg on 3306. No egress.

securityGroups.name: bastion-sg
securityGroups.description: Bastion via SSM Session Manager — no SSH inbound (SSM uses outbound only)

securityGroups.name: vpc-endpoint-sg
securityGroups.description: VPC Interface Endpoints (M2) — accepts HTTPS from app-sg only

ingress.description: HTTPS from ECS Task for endpoint resolution
